name: quizfull

lines.text: Need practice questions before a test?
Pick how many you want, type the topic, and hit generate.
and Memora writes the whole quiz for you.
Give it a name, save it, and start practicing.

_doc: Each line starts at <anchor event> + offset seconds (clip time). A line with end_at instead ENDS at rec_end + offset. tools/place_vo.py resolves these against the recording's events.json.
